brief:
Houston Texans linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair was forced to remove eyeblack bearing the name of Wafaa Akila, an eight-year-old Palestinian girl killed earlier this month, Middle East Eye reported. The player had inscribed the child's name on the black strips worn under the eyes during a recent game.

Details of who ordered the removal and the stated reason were not immediately clear from the available information.
dek: Azeez Al-Shaair forced to remove name of slain Palestinian girl from eyeblack Houston Texans linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair was forced last week to remove an eyeblack that bore the name of Wafaa Akila, an eight-year-old Palestinian girl killed earlier this month…
title: NFL forces Texans linebacker to erase slain Palestinian child's name
